storyCards.headline: Something's Got A Hold On Me: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Etta James's "Something's Got A Hold On Me" reached #37 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #37 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.

Something's Got A Hold On Me was released in 1964.

"Something's Got A Hold On Me" by Etta James.
